name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd.
about: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited, through its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and distributes beauty and lifestyle products in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Beauty, Fashion, and Others. The company offers makeup for face, eyes, lips, and nails, as well as makeup palettes and tools and brushes; body, eye lip, sun, and hands and feet care products, as well as moisturizers, serums, cleansers, masks, toners, skin tools and supplements, neck creams, Korean beauty products, and specialized skincare; hair care and styling products, as well as tools and accessories; appliances; bath and shower, feminine hygiene, female and male grooming products, hygiene essentials, and oral care; and natural products. It also provides diaper essentials, baby accessories and hygiene, nursing and feeding items, and products for moms; health and wellness, including beauty booster

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~55% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 312 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 1500), though that is a short history to judge by.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 124% a year while PE moved 2019 → 312.
